name: 37871 · Straw Plains, TN
findings: ZIP 37871 (Straw Plains) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37871 (Straw Plains) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 37871 (Straw Plains) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
